# Terset

> TERse SETs. It writes a set of records as one terse table, so a model reads the same data with fewer tokens.

The format is frozen at format version 1.0. That number is separate from the package version, which is still 0.x. JavaScript and Python are separate implementations that both pass the conformance suite at `conformance/` in the repository.

{{RELEASE}}. Install it with `{{PNPMADD}}`.

## Start here

- [Agent guide](https://terset.dev/agents.md): Everything an agent needs in one read. When to use Terset, the encode call, the rules sentence and how to read a table.

## Reference

- [Docs](https://terset.dev/docs.md): Install, a quick start, a cheat sheet and the full API for JavaScript and Python, with every error and limit.
- [Specification](https://terset.dev/spec.md): Every rule of the format.
- [Benchmark](https://terset.dev/benchmark.md): Token counts for Terset, JSON, TOON and CSV on every case, with the method and the limits.

## Optional

- [Skill](https://terset.dev/skill/SKILL.md): A skill file any agent harness can load to read and write Terset.
- [Full text](https://terset.dev/llms-full.txt): The agent guide, the docs, the specification and the benchmark in one file.
